question: Modern computers follow a set of instructions to perform any task. These instructions can be better known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Programs**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Modern computers follow a set of instructions to perform any task. These instructions are known as **Programs**.
 
• A program is a collection of instructions that can be executed by a computer to perform a specific task.
 
• Programs are written in programming languages and are essential for computer operations.
 
• Examples of programming languages include Python, Java, C++, and many others.
 
• Commands and guidelines can be part of programs, but they do not encompass the entire set of instructions needed to perform tasks on a computer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Programs can be categorized into system software and application software.
 
• System software includes operating systems and utility programs that manage computer resources.
 
• Application software includes programs that perform specific tasks for users, such as word processors, spreadsheets, and database management systems.
 
• Writing and debugging programs is a fundamental skill for software developers and computer scientists.
 
• Integrated Development Environments (IDEs) are commonly used tools that provide comprehensive facilities to programmers for software development.
